icons.prompt: Generate one simple black outline icon for a desktop application. One rounded square outline with one smaller solid square centered inside. A basic UI element. Transparent background, centered square composition. Crisp solid BLACK strokes only, evenly weighted at about 2 units on a 24 unit grid. Gently rounded ends. Simple geometric shape clear at 20 pixels. Fill about 80 percent of the canvas with balanced margins. No background or tile, no words, no decorative details, no shadows, no gradient. Empty areas including the symbol's interior must be fully transparent.
